Moreover Yugantar is affiliated to Sports Authority of India (SAI) and also to Indira Kala Sangeet Viswavidyalay, Khairagarh.

name: Rajkumar College
description: About Us Rajkumar College, Raipur, is one of the leading Public Schools of the country and the only one in the State of Chhattisgarh. Established in 1882, this is one of the five Chiefs' Colleges along with Mayo College Ajmer, Daly College Indore, Rajkumar College Rajkot and Aitchinson College Lahore, which were established 1860 onwards to educate scions of royal families. Rajkumar College is an institution where excellence is a tradition and we believe that each student is special and has the potential to excel in many different spheres. The founding fathers of the College rightly chose the, College motto as “Swadeshe Pujyate Raja, Vidwan Sarvatra Pujyate”; “A Raja is honoured in his own country, a learned man throughout the world”.In conformity to our motto, we aim to provide quality education in Humanities, Commerce and Science. Through carefully crafted interaction and activities both within and outside the classrooms, we provide experiences that help the student to discover innate capabilities, set life long goals and proactively work towards their fulfillment.The College has as its backbone excellent infrastructure updated teaching laboratories large number of playgrounds and ample facilities for students in hostels classrooms. We give equal emphasis curriculum outdoors. The curriculum soul academic structure school move ahead desirable lines priorities. This website shall speak volumes history ethos activities college. Source : School's Website

description: About Us HAM Academy( Haji Abdul Majid’s Academy) was established in 2006. It is a pre primary to higher secondary school being run under the aegis of the HAM Institute of Technology and Management. HAM Academy currently has two campuses located in Jagdalpur. One campus is CBSE affiliated with affiliation #3330404 and school #16015. We pride ourselves for our dynamic educational policy that stays in touch with the evolving needs of society. The school is co-educational and the medium of instruction is both Hindi and English. We also provide for both residential students as well as day scholars. Our prime objective is to produce an environment conducive for the student’s intellectual, physical and psychological growth and to channelize their boundless energy in a positive direction. HAM Academy is committed to provide quality education and strengthen the minds of young scholars as they grow into tenacious and strong individuals in tune with the school motto- “Service before Self.” Our diverse extra-curricular activities, foreign exchange programmes, focus on sports, cultural events, and several other initiatives allow children to intrepidly bloom, with confidence and creativity as their watchwords. Young students have boldly emerged as winners and achievers; as acclaimed sportsmen, budding professionals and entrepreneur’s in-the-making, and are indeed competent forces to reckon with! Soaring High… We reach for the sky!

name: Gyan Ganga Educational Academy
description: About Us Gyan Ganga Educational Academy came into existence in July 1992 through a joint venture of like minded people, as a body corporate, totally dedicated to the cause of education and community service. The institution has been made self sustainable including it gradual growth and development year, after year, without any donation or grant and achieved high repute of Senior Secondary Co‑Educational English Medium, Residential & Day Boarding Academy certified by the ISO 9001: 2000 for Quality Management System Further the aim of the Academy is to provide Collegiate Education in all branches and disciplines and earn repute as a universal pedestal of learning. In the year 1996 Gyan Ganga Family started their second school namely Gyan Ganga Academy, Bhopal. It is the reputation and the projected image of Raipur school, and overwhelming response of the parents and the public that encouraged the Gyan Ganga family to set up another similar Institution in the capital city of the Madhya Pradesh. In the year 2000 Gyan Ganga Family started their third venture as Gyan Ganga Public School at Jabalpur. In a very span of time the school has established a benchmark in the field of education in Mahakaushal region. It is a joint venture with the Watch man Group, Jabalpur. In the year 2003 we entered into the field of technical education by establishing Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology & Sciences (GGITS) at Jabalpur. The institute is approved by AICTE, New Delhi and is affilited to RGPV, Bhopal. It offers bachelor course in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering.

name: Sanskar City International School
description: About Us to , Rajnandgaon which is affiliated to C.B.S.E. New Delhi with affiliation No. 3330095. Welcome Sanskar City International School is founded on a universally acceptable premise that every child is special with unique abilities and should be encouraged to grow and develop in his or her own way to ensure the achievement of full potential. The school is committed to providing an educational environment in which a variety of talents can thrive and bloom in their own unique way. The school has been set up according to international standards and offers a learning atmosphere that is friendly, personal and disciplined. The stately structure of Sanskar City International School stands imposingly. On sprawling, lush green campus of , 7 km. from City of Sanskar, Rajnandgaon on the Raipur Nagpur state highway. The state of the art infrastructure will have an Academic Block, Administrator Block, Separate hostel Blocks for boys & girls with excellent lodging & boarding arrangements and a dining hall for over 600 students. The school will have staff quarters in the school campus so that the teachers are always available for the students. An auditorium for various culture activities and competition & school building having large size fully furnished & well ventilated class room is also proposed. The school aims to assist children in their endeavours to develop their individual talents and teach them to relate the experience of the class room to the realities of the world outside. Beyond intellectual rigour and high academic standards, Strong emphasis is laid on International understanding and responsible citizenship, so that the students of Sanskar City International School may become compassionate and critical thinkers, lifelong learners and informed participants. 27.5 acres forms an integral part of the school educational program and the school has almost all the facilities for games and sports within its premises. The students are encouraged to participate in various local & state level tournaments. Facilities are available for sports like cricket, hockey, football, volley ball, badmintorn, basketball, table tennis, carrom etc. Along with these facilities the school also has a sand track, high jump and long jump facilities for the budding athletes. A swimming pool is also proposed in the future to produce fine swimmers. “All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy” Physical Education Our Mission & Vision Know more about our school's Mission & Vision... To provide an exciting & enthusiastic environment where innovativeness & creativity grow. As its suggests the school endeavours to provide international standard education (vidya) based on Indian cultural values (Sanskar) & upholding Indian traditions . synergising its rich cultural heritage with modern word. OBJECTIVES The school has a commitment to the highest standard of education for all pupils. To develop talented and responsible citizens. The emphasis is on care, providing excellent education, treating the pupil as a complete individual, ensuring abilities and talents are nurtured and developed. Inculcating a spirit of research and creativity. Providing a safe, secure, positive and enjoyable environment that builds self-esteem, self-confidence and the essential attitude necessary to become a supportive member of the society. Developing an awareness of and respect for the diverse language, cultures, customs and religions.

name: Shri Sai Baba School
description: About Us Shri Sai Baba School has pioneered the concept of ‘Day Boarding School’ in Surguja region. This concept of education focuses on the ‘Total education’ synchronizes the school activities academic, games, sports, arts, craft, music, social works, etc. for the holistic development of students. Eating meals together in the mess fosters the feeling of benevolence among the students. Schooling in this environment leads to a complete education which we call as the ‘Total Education’. Home-work for kindergarten students is done with teachers’ assistance at the school itself. The care and affection cultivates a stress free environment that makes learning easy and fun. FOOD / MESS A multi cuisine food mess caters to the needs & tastes of the students. Pure vegetarian, delicious & nutritious meals are prepared in extremely hygienic surroundings. The mess serves appetizing & nutritious meals. REGULAR HEALTH CHEK-UP School is concerned about the physical growth of our children. Regular health check-ups are done, records of health are maintained, and growth in height and weight is monitored. We believe that a healthy body makes a healthy mind.
